The treatment philosophy is guided by the belief that services should be provided as early in a child's development as possible, be individualized for each child and family, and support the unique culture of each family. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the principles and practical application of ABA treatment.
cond_0526.responsibilities:
You will be integral to ensuring the highest possible treatment outcomes for families affected by ASD. As a member of the [Company name masked] Interdisciplinary Team, the BCBA designs and manages individualized behavior programming including:
Managing RBTs/ BTs
Supervising direct 1:1 ABA service delivery
Conducting behavior assessments
Individualizing client treatment goals and objectives
Conducting monthly caregiver training
Coordinating with other professionals on your clients' treatment team
cond_0526.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Master's Degree in Applied Behavior Analysis or related field
BCBA Certification - Must hold a current certification by the BACB
Preferred Requirements
BCBAs that require additional experience will be enrolled in our BCBA mentorship program

Since establishment in 2005, [Company name masked] has positively impacted over 13,000 families. The mission is to deliver personalized ABA treatment in partnership with affected families, fostering a more joyous life. Conducting behavior assessments
Individualizing client treatment goals and objectives
Conducting monthly caregiver training
Coordinating with other professionals on your clients' treatment team

Master's Degree in Applied Behavior Analysis or related field
BCBA Certification - Must hold a current certification by the BACB
